# `Ui.Animation`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Ui.Animation — typed CSS keyframe animations for `Ipe.Ui`.

`Animation.attribute { name, duration, easing, delay, iterations,
fillMode, respectReducedMotion, keyframes }` builds a keyframe
animation spec and attaches it to a Ipe.Ui element.  Auto-wrapped
in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` by default for
a11y; opt out via `respectReducedMotion = False` ONLY when motion
is semantically required (loading spinner, progress indicator).

The animation shorthand and `@keyframes` body are emitted through
`Ui.animate`, both scanned by the native CSS sanitiser at the
render sink.

## `defaultSpec`

```ipe
defaultSpec : String -> Spec
```

`defaultSpec "fadeIn"` — Spec with sensible defaults: 300ms
linear easing, no delay, plays once, no fill mode, respects
prefers-reduced-motion (a11y safe).  Empty `keyframes` list — the
spec animates nothing until `withKeyframes` populates it.

## `withDuration`

```ipe
withDuration : Int -> Spec -> Spec
```

`withDuration 500 spec` — replace the duration in milliseconds.

## `withEasing`

```ipe
withEasing : Easing -> Spec -> Spec
```

`withEasing easeOut spec` — replace the easing curve.

## `withDelay`

```ipe
withDelay : Int -> Spec -> Spec
```

`withDelay 100 spec` — replace the delay before animation starts.

## `withIterations`

```ipe
withIterations : Iterations -> Spec -> Spec
```

`withIterations infinite spec` — replace the iteration count.

## `withFillMode`

```ipe
withFillMode : FillMode -> Spec -> Spec
```

`withFillMode forwards spec` — replace the post-animation state.

## `withRespectReducedMotion`

```ipe
withRespectReducedMotion : Bool -> Spec -> Spec
```

`withRespectReducedMotion False spec` — opt out of the prefers-
reduced-motion a11y wrapper.  Use ONLY when motion is semantically
required (loading spinner, progress indicator).

## `withKeyframes`

```ipe
withKeyframes : List ( Int, List Prop ) -> Spec -> Spec
```

`withKeyframes [(0, [Transform.opacity (Css.opacityOf 0.0)]), (100, [Transform.opacity (Css.opacityOf 1.0)])] spec`
— replace the entire keyframe list.
